g.text: The Wallet Instance selects exactly one trust path at issuance.
EUDIW: validate the access-certificate-signed Issuer Metadata
National: evaluate Federation Entity Authentication and National
Authorization, then obtain the applicable final metadata.
signed metadata with WRPAC and WRPRC
get Provider of WRPAC and WRPRC LoTEs
validate WRPAC path and metadata signature
applicable final metadata and registration Trust Mark
validate Trust Chain and Trust Mark,
obtain applicable Wallet Provider trust material
Wallet Provider Trust Anchor and status result
Validate the Request Object and Credential identifiers.
Validate the Wallet Provider, WIA signature and certificate
chain, temporal validity, revocation status, and PoP.
Abort issuance if any trust check fails.
The request_uri MUST be present, unexpired, and unused;
it identifies the previously submitted PAR request.
Authenticate the User with CieID LoA High (CIE L3)
and obtain consent, optionally collecting contact details.
Authenticate the User with CieID LoA High (CIE L3) or
eID Substantial Authentication with MRTD Verification,
then obtain consent and optionally collect contact details.
Obtain a valid PID or IT-Wallet ID from the Wallet Instance
through OpenID4VP, then obtain consent and optionally
generate a fresh DPoP key pair
generate DPoP proof for the token endpoint
obtain applicable Wallet Provider trust material
Wallet Provider Trust Anchor and status result
Validate the authorization code, its binding to the
authenticated Wallet Instance, redirect_uri, DPoP proof,
and PKCE code_verifier. Repeat the Wallet Provider, WIA
signature and chain, validity, status, and PoP checks.
create DPoP proof for the Credential Endpoint
create proof of possession with c_nonce
Credential Request with DPoP access token
generate N fresh Credential key pairs
generate N key proofs with the same c_nonce
Batch Credential Request with DPoP access token
proofs (proof1, proof2, ..., proofN with Key Attestations))
obtain applicable Wallet Provider trust material
Wallet Provider Trust Anchor and status result
Validate the DPoP proof, Access Token, and every key proof.
Validate each Key Attestation signature and certificate chain,
validity, status, PoP, and applicable key-protection policy.
The number of issued Credentials MUST equal the number of
key proofs; in a batch, each proof MUST use a unique key.
Register issued credentials for later revocation.
Inform the User or wait for the indicated interval.
The Wallet Instance presents a valid Access Token at the
Deferred Endpoint. If it expires, use the Refresh Token Flow
when available; otherwise a new authenticated issuance is needed.
The same transaction_id retrieves all deferred batch credentials.
wait for interval or User/local notification
validate every Credential signature and related trust
and format; associate any resolved EDP with each EAA
request User consent to store Credential(s)
For a batch, one notification_id covers the batch;
a partial batch failure fails the batch.
